description: Pro: change how one ticket type's tickets look (each type can differ, e.g. VIP gold, General plain). `settings` uses the theme's ticket_* settings (get_site lists them, in the Ticket group); unset values follow the theme's ticket settings, and those follow the site's colors. null resets the type. Ticket type ids come from list_events. Change the look of every ticket with update_theme_settings instead.

anyOf.description: Settings as a JSON merge patch (null removes a key). get_site lists each type's settings.

settings.description: Merge patch on how this ticket type looks, using the theme's ticket_* settings; null makes it follow the theme again

name: update_ticket_design
title: Update ticket design
